# Viilasa — WhatsApp Lead Qualifier & Real Estate Automation (UAE)

> Viilasa builds WhatsApp lead qualifiers and automation for real-estate teams in Dubai and the UAE. Filter property inquiries by budget, area, timeline, and intent before they reach your agents.

## Primary service

**WhatsApp Lead Qualifier for Real Estate**

- 24/7 automated first reply on WhatsApp
- Lead qualification: budget, area, timeline, buyer intent
- Hot-lead handoff to agents with full conversation context
- Works with existing WhatsApp Business numbers
- English standard; Arabic available on request
- Custom setup for brokerages, off-plan teams, and luxury agents

## Who we serve

- Dubai brokerages and luxury resale teams
- Off-plan specialists and developer sales teams
- Boutique real-estate agencies across the UAE
- Property agents flooded with unqualified WhatsApp inquiries
